title: (111) Facet-engineered SnO2 as an electron transport layer for efficient and stable triple-cation perovskite solar cells
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,3102-3109
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00339C, Paper
Keshav Kumar Sharma, Rohit Saini, Sochannao Machinao, Ramesh Karuppannan
We have achieved a breakthrough in power conversion efficiency (20.34%) of triple-cation perovskite solar cells using (111) facet-engineered cubic SnO2 ETL.
